# Docua

> Experimental LibreOffice interface extension for macOS Apple Silicon. LibreOffice retains its document engine and canvas.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Project scope, build commands, and source layout.
- [Installation](docs/installation.md): Install, update, remove, and recover Docua.
- [How Docua works](docs/how-it-works.md): Beginner explanation of LibreOffice and the extension.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Registration, layout, commands, native bridge, and packaging.
- [Releasing](docs/releasing.md): Experimental release preparation and testing.
- [Terminology](docs/terminology.md): Consistent project terms.
